# asc_volume_attachment (Resource)

Attaches a block volume to a virtual machine through ASC infra-gateway.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "asc_volume_attachment" "example" {
  volume_name = asc_volume.example.name
  vm_name     = asc_virtual_machine.example.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `vm_name` (String) Name of the virtual machine to attach the volume to. Moving a volume to another machine detaches it and attaches it again, so this forces replacement.
- `volume_name` (String) Name of the volume to attach.

### Read-Only

- `last_error` (String) Last error reported for the volume, empty when there is none.
- `status` (String) Status the volume reports while attached.
